title: Hyderabadi wedding catering — four menus, shaped around you
description: Hyderabadi wedding catering from The Wedding Nest: four set menus, from Deccani Delight to Shahi Dastarkhwaan, each open to your own changes and additions.
introduction: Catering is at the heart of The Wedding Nest. Choose from four Hyderabadi menus, from the simple Deccani Delight to the Shahi Dastarkhwaan, then tell us what you would like changed. Each menu is a starting point, and we shape it around your family and your guests.

sections.title: Deccani Delight
sections.body: “Simple flavors, true Hyderabadi soul.” Platter: Veg Rolls, Stick Chicken, Chicken Pakoda, Chicken Strips. Main course: Chicken Harees, Tandoori Chicken, Dum Ka Chicken, Kashmiri Pulao, Mirchi Ka Salan, Dahi Ki Chatni. Main table: Chicken Leg Roast, Kaddu Ka Meetha. Desserts: 5 Star Qubani, Kashmiri Rabdi. Green salad, Rumali Roti and water bottles.

sections.title: Nawabi Zaiqa
sections.body: “A royal touch in every bite.” Platter: Veg Rolls, Crispy Fish, Panko Chicken, Tandoori Chicken. Main course: Mutton Harees or Mutton Marag, Achari Chicken, Pepper Chicken, Zaffrani Mutton Biryani, Mirchi Ka Salan, Dahi Ki Chatni. Main table: Chicken Leg Roast, Mutton Mandi, Joyzi Halwa. Desserts: Cream Fruit Salad, Litchi Rabdi. Green and Russian salad, Mulayam Naan, Laccha Paratha.

sections.title: Daawat-E-Khaas
sections.body: “For those who savor the special.” Seafood platter: Golden Fried Prawns, Crispy Fish. Mix platter: Veg Rolls, Malai Cheese Roll, Chicken Tikka Kebab. Main course: Mutton Marag, Achari Chicken, Pepper Chicken, Zaffrani Mutton Biryani, Mirchi Ka Salan, Dahi Ki Chatni. Main table: Chicken Leg Roast, Mutton Mandi, Mutton Kareli, Joyzi Halwa. Desserts: Fruit Punch, Malayi Rabdi. Salads, Afghani Naan, Laccha Paratha.

sections.title: Shahi Dastarkhwaan
sections.body: “The grandeur of Hyderabad on your table.” Shahi platter: Adana Kebab, Mulayam Luqmi. Seafood and mix platters with prawns, fish and cheese rolls. Main course includes Kadayi Mutton and Zaffrani Mutton Biryani. Main table: Chicken Leg Roast, Mutton Mandi, Mutton Kareli, Mutton Chops, Joyzi Halwa. Desserts: Fruit Punch, Kaddu Ka Meetha, Kashmiri Rabdi. Tea and Paan counters.

sections.title: Add-ons and your own menu
sections.body: Add live counters, cotton candy, popcorn, a fruit cocktail or royal crockery, and more. Every package is a starting point: tell us what you would like to add, swap or leave out, and we will shape the menu around your family, your guests and the occasion. We do not publish set prices, because the right menu depends on what you ask for.
